# PETadex.v260701 Creation: 6. Cleaning the Logan-DIAMONDx results

> **Author:** Thomas Quigley\
> **Date Started:** October 4th, 2026\
> **Date Finished:** 
> **Input:** \
> s3://serratus-rayan/beetles/logan_sep30_26_run/all-concat/peta*
> **Output:** \
---

## 1. Objective
Rayan has ran a DIAMONDx alignment search through the Logan contigs, and has returned the results to me. The size of the results is ~10 TB, with ~2.6 TB compressed (100 results zst). Therefore, I am going to go through each of the compressed files one at a time, run the HMMsearch to get only significant hits, then parse the headers into tsv format.

### 1.1. Place in the Project
---
We have finished the Logan search! Huzzah! Now we have to subset the search set into partial and complete hits, so we can widdle this big big dataset down.

## 2. Methods
### 2.0. Install requirements
---
- HMMER 3.4 (Aug 2023); http://hmmer.org/


### 2.0.1. Downloading search results
---
Rayan has ran the DIAMONDx search through the Logan contigs. I am downloading the results (~10 TB), and will further process it.


```bash
%%bash 

s5cmd cp "s3://serratus-rayan/beetles/logan_sep30_26_run/all-concat/peta*" ../s3/6_logan_search
```

#### 2.0.1. Manual check: count the DIAMONDx rows
---
Counts the rows (one DIAMONDx hit per line) in every compressed `.pro.zst` result file. The total is compared against the rows 2.1 parsed and the rows in the parquet in section 2.1.2. Counts are cached in `./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/logan_diamondx_row_counts.tsv`.


```bash
%%bash

# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #
# MANUAL CHECK: COUNT THE LOGAN-DIAMONDX ROWS  #
# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #
# Counts the rows (one DIAMONDx hit per line) in every compressed result file,
# so the total can be compared against the rows parsed into the parquet in 2.1.

# ─── INPUT  ─── #
LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR="../s3/6_logan_search/logan_diamond_results" # .pro.zst files

# ─── OUTPUT  ─── #
ROW_COUNTS_TSV="./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/logan_diamondx_row_counts.tsv" # file<TAB>rows, one line per .pro.zst, plus a TOTAL line

# ─── PARAMETERS  ─── #
N_JOBS=32  # files decompressed in parallel (each is a zstd -dc | wc -l pipe)

mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}")"

if [[ -s "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}" ]]; then
  echo "Using cached counts from ${ROW_COUNTS_TSV} (delete it to recount)"
else
  find "${LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR}" -name "*.pro.zst" -print0 \
    | xargs -0 -P "${N_JOBS}" -I{} bash -c 'printf "%s\t%s\n" "$(basename "$1")" "$(zstd -dcf "$1" | wc -l)"' _ {} \
    | sort > "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}.tmp"
  awk -F'\t' '{ total += $2 } END { printf "TOTAL\t%d\n", total }' "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}.tmp" >> "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}.tmp"
  mv -- "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}.tmp" "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}"
fi

echo
echo "files: $(grep -vc '^TOTAL' "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}")"
awk -F'\t' '$1 != "TOTAL" { print $2 }' "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}" | sort -n | awk '{ a[NR] = $1 } END { printf "rows per file: min %\047d | median %\047d | max %\047d\n", a[1], a[int((NR + 1) / 2)], a[NR] }'
awk -F'\t' '$1 == "TOTAL" { printf "TOTAL rows: %\047d\n", $2 }' "${ROW_COUNTS_TSV}"
```

### 2.1. Parse the Logan-DIAMONDx results
---
This section will screen through each of the 100 compressed Logan Contig DIAMONDx result files one at a time and perform the following: 
- Clean the header into tsv format
- Add the header information to a parquet
- ORF call )stop-stop) the DNA sequence and find the frame and ORF that produces an exact substring match to the translated_hit_region
- If there is an internal stop codon that splits the translated_hit_region, split the hit into two separate ORFs. If the one side is &lt;30 aa in size, then don't include it, since it's not a protein
- Split the hits into compressed fastaas per component. Therefore there will be 46 component fastaas per 100 files (4600 files) to search through.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #

print("Starting up...")

import glob, io, itertools, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import multiprocessing as mp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ─── INPUT ─── #
LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR = "../s3/6_logan_search/logan_diamond_results" # .pro.zst files
""" Column format (tsv):
qseqid = Logan contig accession --> {SRA_library}_{contig}_{kmer_graph}
qstart = start nt of the alignment
qend = end nt of the alignment
qlen = length of contig
qstrand = which strand the alignment was found (+ or -)
sseqid = subject sequence petadex.v260701.logan_query.{petadex_id}|domain_start_aa|domain_end_aa|component
sstart = start aa of the subjects alignment
send = end aa of the subjects alignment
slen = total length of the subject
pident = percentage identity between the two aligned regions
evalue = e-value
cigar = short form to represent alignment
qseq_translation = the translated aa for the alignment (not full length)
contig = full query nt contig
"""

# ─── WORKING ─── #
WORKING_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/tmp" # flush contents of directory after each file ran


# ─── OUTPUT ─── #
SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/component_fastaas" # 100 per component petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa
"""Format:
>{SRA_library}_{contig}_{kmer_graph}|{e-value}|{pid}|{subject_petadex_id}|{component_id}
{translated_orf_aa_seq}
"""

SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/petadex.v260701.logan_query_raw.parquet"
"""Format:
sra_library = from qsedid
contig = from qsedid
kmer_graph = from qsedid
subject_petadex_id = taken from the sseqid
component_id = taken from the sseqid
qstart = start nt of the alignment
qend = end nt of the alignment
qlen = length of contig
qstrand = which strand the alignment was found (+ or -)
pident = percentage identity between the two aligned regions
evalue = e-value
"""

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
N_WORKERS = 100                  # one streaming worker per .pro.zst (each also spawns 1 zstd -dc + <=46 zstd compressors)
MIN_ORF_AA = 30                  # drop ORF pieces shorter than this after splitting on internal stops
MIN_FREE_BYTES = 1 * 1024**4     # pause writing if free space on the output filesystem drops below 1 TB
PARQUET_BATCH_ROWS = 1_000_000   # rows buffered per worker before flushing a parquet row group
FASTA_FLUSH_BYTES = 4 * 1024**2  # per-component write buffer before piping to zstd
QLEN_HIST_CAP = 200_000          # contig lengths >= this go into the last histogram bin
TEST_MAX_LINES = None            # set to e.g. 20_000 to dry-run on the first lines of the smallest file

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.dirname(SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET)
DONE_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR), "done") # restart markers + per-file stats
for d in (WORKING_DIR, SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR, SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET, OUTPUT_DIR, DONE_DIR):
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)

# ──────────────────────────────── #
# PARSE THE LOGAN-DIAMONDX RESULTS #
# ──────────────────────────────── #

_BASES = "TCAG"
_AAS = "FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON = {a + b + c: aa for (a, b, c), aa in zip(itertools.product(_BASES, repeat=3), _AAS)}
STOPS = frozenset(("TAA", "TAG", "TGA"))
COMP = str.maketrans("ACGTNacgtn", "TGCANtgcan")

PARQUET_SCHEMA = pa.schema([
    ("sra_library", pa.string()),
    ("contig", pa.string()),
    ("kmer_graph", pa.string()),
    ("subject_petadex_id", pa.string()),
    ("component_id", pa.dictionary(pa.int8(), pa.string())),
    ("qstart", pa.int32()),
    ("qend", pa.int32()),
    ("qlen", pa.int32()),
    ("qstrand", pa.dictionary(pa.int8(), pa.string())),
    ("pident", pa.float32()),
    ("evalue", pa.float64()),
])


def translate(seq, a, b, get=CODON.get):
    return "".join([get(seq[k:k + 3], "X") for k in range(a, b - 2, 3)])


def hit_matches(trans, hit_pep):
    # DIAMOND masks low-complexity query residues as X in qseq_translation -> treat X as a wildcard
    if trans == hit_pep:
        return True
    return len(trans) == len(hit_pep) and all(h == "X" or h == t for t, h in zip(trans, hit_pep))


def orf_pieces(contig, qstart, qend, strand, hit_pep):
    """Stop-to-stop ORF around the hit, split on internal stops. Returns (pieces, status)."""
    L = len(contig)
    if strand == "+":
        seq, s, e = contig, qstart - 1, qend
    else: # DIAMOND reports minus-strand hits in forward coordinates with qstart > qend
        seq, s, e = contig.translate(COMP)[::-1], L - qstart, L - qend + 1
    hit_trans = translate(seq, s, e)
    if not hit_matches(hit_trans, hit_pep):
        # fallback: find the frame of this strand whose translation contains the hit peptide
        pattern = re.compile(re.escape(hit_pep).replace("X", "."))
        for f in range(3):
            m = pattern.search(translate(seq, f, L))
            if m:
                s = f + 3 * m.start()
                e = s + 3 * len(hit_pep)
                hit_trans = translate(seq, s, e)
                break
        else:
            return [], "frame_mismatch"
    i = s - 3
    while i >= 0 and seq[i:i + 3] not in STOPS:
        i -= 3
    j = e
    while j + 3 <= L and seq[j:j + 3] not in STOPS:
        j += 3
    orf = translate(seq, i + 3, s) + hit_trans + translate(seq, e, j)
    return orf.split("*"), "ok"


def wait_for_space(path):
    while shutil.disk_usage(path).free < MIN_FREE_BYTES:
        print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] <{MIN_FREE_BYTES/1024**4:.1f} TB free, pausing", flush=True)
        time.sleep(300)


def process_file(path, n, max_lines=None):
    t0 = time.time()
    stage = os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, n)
    shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(stage)
    wait_for_space(OUTPUT_DIR)

    # ─── UNCOMPRESS DIAMOND RESULT (streamed, never written to disk) ─── #
    dec = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-dcq", path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=1 << 24)
    lines = io.TextIOWrapper(dec.stdout, encoding="ascii", newline="\n")

    parquet_path = os.path.join(stage, f"part-{n}.parquet")
    writer = pq.ParquetWriter(parquet_path, PARQUET_SCHEMA, compression="zstd")
    cols = {k: [] for k in PARQUET_SCHEMA.names}
    qlen_hist = np.zeros(QLEN_HIST_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)

    fasta_procs, fasta_bufs, fasta_buf_bytes = {}, {}, {}
    n_orfs, raw_bytes = {}, {}
    stats = {"rows": 0, "frame_mismatch": 0, "split_hits": 0, "short_piece_dropped": 0}

    def flush_parquet():
        nonlocal qlen_hist
        if not cols["qlen"]:
            return
        writer.write_table(pa.table(cols, schema=PARQUET_SCHEMA))
        qlen_hist += np.bincount(np.minimum(np.asarray(cols["qlen"]), QLEN_HIST_CAP), minlength=QLEN_HIST_CAP + 1)
        for v in cols.values():
            v.clear()

    def flush_fasta(comp):
        data = "".join(fasta_bufs[comp]).encode()
        fasta_procs[comp].stdin.write(data)
        raw_bytes[comp] += len(data)
        fasta_bufs[comp].clear()
        fasta_buf_bytes[comp] = 0

    c_sra, c_contig, c_kmer, c_subj, c_comp = (cols[k] for k in ("sra_library", "contig", "kmer_graph", "subject_petadex_id", "component_id"))
    c_qs, c_qe, c_ql, c_strand, c_pid, c_ev = (cols[k] for k in ("qstart", "qend", "qlen", "qstrand", "pident", "evalue"))

    for line in itertools.islice(lines, max_lines):
        # ─── PARSE HEADER ─── #
        (qseqid, qstart, qend, qlen, strand, sseqid, _sstart, _send, _slen,
         pident, evalue, _cigar, hit_pep, contig) = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        sra, contig_id, kmer = qseqid.split("_", 2)
        sfields = sseqid.split("|")
        subject = sfields[0].rsplit(".", 1)[1]
        comp = sfields[3]
        qstart, qend, qlen = int(qstart), int(qend), int(qlen)

        # ─── ADD HEADER TO PARQUET ─── #
        c_sra.append(sra); c_contig.append(contig_id); c_kmer.append(kmer); c_subj.append(subject); c_comp.append(comp)
        c_qs.append(qstart); c_qe.append(qend); c_ql.append(qlen); c_strand.append(strand)
        c_pid.append(float(pident)); c_ev.append(float(evalue))
        stats["rows"] += 1
        if len(c_ql) >= PARQUET_BATCH_ROWS:
            flush_parquet()
            wait_for_space(OUTPUT_DIR)

        # ─── RETRIEVE FULL ORF THAT CONTAINS THE qseq_translation ─── #
        pieces, status = orf_pieces(contig, qstart, qend, strand, hit_pep)
        if status != "ok":
            stats[status] += 1
            continue

        # ─── SPLIT HITS BY INTENRAL STOP CODONS ─── #
        split = len(pieces) > 1
        stats["split_hits"] += split
        if comp not in fasta_procs:
            out = os.path.join(stage, f"petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{comp}.fa.zst")
            fasta_procs[comp] = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-3", "-T1", "-o", out], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=1 << 20)
            fasta_bufs[comp], fasta_buf_bytes[comp], n_orfs[comp], raw_bytes[comp] = [], 0, 0, 0

        # ─── WRITE FASTAA ─── #
        buf = fasta_bufs[comp]
        tail = f"|{evalue}|{pident}|{subject}|{comp}\n"
        for k, pep in enumerate(pieces, 1):
            if len(pep) < MIN_ORF_AA:
                stats["short_piece_dropped"] += 1
                continue
            rec = f">{qseqid}{'.' + str(k) if split else ''}{tail}{pep}\n"
            buf.append(rec)
            fasta_buf_bytes[comp] += len(rec)
            n_orfs[comp] += 1
        if fasta_buf_bytes[comp] >= FASTA_FLUSH_BYTES:
            flush_fasta(comp)

    if max_lines is not None:
        dec.kill()
    elif dec.wait() != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"zstd -dc failed on {path}")
    flush_parquet()
    writer.close()

    # ─── COMPRESS FASTAA (close the per-component zstd pipes) ─── #
    for comp, proc in fasta_procs.items():
        flush_fasta(comp)
        proc.stdin.close()
        if proc.wait() != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"zstd compression failed for {n}.{comp}")

    # move staged outputs into place (same filesystem -> rename, no copy)
    zst_bytes = {}
    for comp in fasta_procs:
        name = f"petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{comp}.fa.zst"
        zst_bytes[comp] = os.path.getsize(os.path.join(stage, name))
        os.replace(os.path.join(stage, name), os.path.join(SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR, name))
    os.replace(parquet_path, os.path.join(SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET, f"part-{n}.parquet"))
    shutil.rmtree(stage)

    result = {"file": n, "in_bytes": os.path.getsize(path), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), **stats,
              "n_orfs": n_orfs, "raw_bytes": raw_bytes, "zst_bytes": zst_bytes}
    if max_lines is None:
        np.save(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, f"qlen_hist.{n}.npy"), qlen_hist)
        with open(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, f"done.{n}.json"), "w") as fh:
            json.dump(result, fh)
    return result, qlen_hist


# ─── RUN: ONE STREAMING WORKER PER FILE, LARGEST FIRST ─── #
input_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR, "*.pro.zst")), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)
file_id = lambda p: re.search(r"-(\d+)\.pro\.zst$", p).group(1)

if TEST_MAX_LINES:
    test_file = input_files[-1]
    result, _ = process_file(test_file, file_id(test_file), max_lines=TEST_MAX_LINES)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=1))
else:
    todo = [p for p in input_files if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, f"done.{file_id(p)}.json"))]
    print(f"{len(input_files) - len(todo)} files already done, {len(todo)} to run with {N_WORKERS} workers")
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_WORKERS, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as pool:
        futures = {pool.submit(process_file, p, file_id(p)): p for p in todo}
        out_bytes = in_bytes = 0
        for fut in as_completed(futures):
            res, _ = fut.result()
            in_bytes += res["in_bytes"]
            out_bytes += sum(res["zst_bytes"].values()) + os.path.getsize(os.path.join(SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET, f"part-{res['file']}.parquet"))
            total_in = sum(map(os.path.getsize, input_files))
            print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {res['file']}: {res['rows']:,} rows in {res['seconds']/60:.1f} min | "
                  f"projected output {out_bytes / in_bytes * total_in / 1024**4:.2f} TB | "
                  f"free {shutil.disk_usage(OUTPUT_DIR).free / 1024**4:.2f} TB", flush=True)

# ──────────────────────── #
# WRITE SUMMARY STATISTICS #
# ──────────────────────── #
if not TEST_MAX_LINES:
    done = [json.load(open(f)) for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, "done.*.json")))]
    qlen_hist = sum(np.load(f) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, "qlen_hist.*.npy")))

    # ─── TABLE OF SEQUENCES AND COMPONENT TB (COMPRESSED vs. UNCOMPRESSED) PER COMPONENT ─── #
    per_comp = pd.DataFrame([
        {"component_id": c, "n_orfs": d["n_orfs"][c], "uncompressed_bytes": d["raw_bytes"][c], "compressed_bytes": d["zst_bytes"][c]}
        for d in done for c in d["n_orfs"]
    ]).groupby("component_id").sum()
    per_comp["uncompressed_TB"] = per_comp["uncompressed_bytes"] / 1024**4
    per_comp["compressed_TB"] = per_comp["compressed_bytes"] / 1024**4
    per_comp["compression_ratio"] = per_comp["uncompressed_bytes"] / per_comp["compressed_bytes"]
    per_comp.loc["TOTAL"] = per_comp.sum()
    per_comp.loc["TOTAL", "compression_ratio"] = per_comp.loc["TOTAL", "uncompressed_bytes"] / per_comp.loc["TOTAL", "compressed_bytes"]
    per_comp.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "logan_query_component_summary.tsv"), sep="\t")
    display(per_comp)
    print({k: sum(d[k] for d in done) for k in ("rows", "frame_mismatch", "split_hits", "short_piece_dropped")})

    # ─── HISTOGRAM OF THE CONTIG LENGTHS ─── #
    lengths = np.arange(QLEN_HIST_CAP + 1)
    bins = np.logspace(np.log10(max(lengths[qlen_hist > 0].min(), 1)), np.log10(QLEN_HIST_CAP + 1), 80)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    ax.hist(lengths, bins=bins, weights=qlen_hist, color="#4C72B0")
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_xlabel("Contig length (nt)")
    ax.set_ylabel("DIAMONDx hits")
    ax.set_title(f"Logan contig lengths ({qlen_hist.sum():,} hits)")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "logan_query_contig_length_hist.png"), dpi=200)
    plt.show()
```

#### 2.1.1. Manual check: example rows through the parser
---
Follows one DIAMONDx row per case through every 2.1 step: raw `.pro` row → parsed header → parquet row → stop-to-stop ORF → split on internal stops → records written to the component fastaa. The cases are:
- **A.** no internal stop codon (one ORF)
- **B.** an internal stop codon splits the hit into two valid ORFs (both ≥ 30 aa)
- **C.** an internal stop codon splits the hit, but only one side is a valid ORF (the other &lt; 30 aa)

The ORF is re-derived with independent code and compared against what 2.1 wrote.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #
# MANUAL CHECK: follows representative DIAMONDx rows through every 2.1 step —
# raw .pro row -> parsed header -> parquet row -> stop-to-stop ORF -> split on
# internal stops -> records written to the component fastaa — for three cases:
#   A. no internal stop codon (one ORF)
#   B. an internal stop codon splits the hit into two valid ORFs (both >= MIN_ORF_AA)
#   C. an internal stop codon splits the hit, but only one side is a valid ORF
# The ORF is re-derived here with its own code (not 2.1's functions), so the
# check is independent, then compared against what 2.1 actually wrote.

import glob, os, re, subprocess, textwrap
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

# ─── INPUT ─── #
LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR = "../s3/6_logan_search/logan_diamond_results" # .pro.zst files
SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/component_fastaas" # petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa.zst
SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/petadex.v260701.logan_query_raw.parquet" # part-{n}.parquet

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
MIN_ORF_AA = 30              # must match 2.1
MAX_SCAN_LINES = 5_000_000   # rows of the example file scanned for the three cases
WRAP = 100                   # characters per printed sequence line

PRO_COLUMNS = ["qseqid", "qstart", "qend", "qlen", "qstrand", "sseqid", "sstart", "send", "slen",
               "pident", "evalue", "cigar", "qseq_translation", "contig"]

_BASES = "TCAG"
_AAS = "FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON_TABLE = {a + b + c: _AAS[16 * i + 4 * j + k]
               for i, a in enumerate(_BASES) for j, b in enumerate(_BASES) for k, c in enumerate(_BASES)}
REVERSE_COMPLEMENT = str.maketrans("ACGTNacgtn", "TGCANtgcan")

# ─────────────────── #
# INDEPENDENT ORF CALL #
# ─────────────────── #

def translate_frame(seq, frame):
    return "".join(CODON_TABLE.get(seq[i:i + 3], "X") for i in range(frame, len(seq) - 2, 3))


def peptide_matches(translated, hit_pep):
    # DIAMOND writes low-complexity-masked residues as X
    return len(translated) == len(hit_pep) and all(h == "X" or h == t for t, h in zip(translated, hit_pep))


def call_orf(row):
    """Returns (orf_with_stops, hit_start_aa, hit_end_aa, pieces) or None if the reported coordinates don't reproduce the hit."""
    contig, L = row["contig"], len(row["contig"])
    qstart, qend = int(row["qstart"]), int(row["qend"])
    if row["qstrand"] == "+":
        seq, start0, end = contig, qstart - 1, qend
    else:  # minus-strand hits are reported in forward coordinates with qstart > qend
        seq, start0, end = contig.translate(REVERSE_COMPLEMENT)[::-1], L - qstart, L - qend + 1
    frame = start0 % 3
    protein = translate_frame(seq, frame)
    a, b = (start0 - frame) // 3, (end - frame) // 3
    if not peptide_matches(protein[a:b], row["qseq_translation"]):
        return None
    left = protein.rfind("*", 0, a) + 1             # first residue after the upstream stop (or the frame start)
    right = protein.find("*", b)                     # the downstream stop (or the frame end)
    right = len(protein) if right == -1 else right
    orf = protein[left:right]
    return orf, a - left, b - left, orf.split("*")


def classify(pieces):
    kept = [p for p in pieces if len(p) >= MIN_ORF_AA]
    if len(pieces) == 1:
        return "A" if kept else None
    return {1: "C", 2: "B"}.get(len(kept))


def expected_records(row, pieces):
    sfields = row["sseqid"].split("|")
    subject, comp = sfields[0].rsplit(".", 1)[1], sfields[3]
    split = len(pieces) > 1
    tail = f"|{row['evalue']}|{row['pident']}|{subject}|{comp}"
    return [(f">{row['qseqid']}{'.' + str(k) if split else ''}{tail}", pep)
            for k, pep in enumerate(pieces, 1) if len(pep) >= MIN_ORF_AA]

# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #
# SCAN THE SMALLEST RESULT FILE FOR EACH CASE  #
# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #

example_path = min(glob.glob(os.path.join(LOGAN_DIAMONDX_RESULTS_DIR, "*.pro.zst")), key=os.path.getsize)
n = re.search(r"-(\d+)\.pro\.zst$", example_path).group(1)
examples = {}

dec = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-dcf", example_path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1 << 20)
for i, line in enumerate(dec.stdout):
    if i >= MAX_SCAN_LINES or len(examples) == 3:
        break
    row = dict(zip(PRO_COLUMNS, line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")))
    has_stop = "*" in row["qseq_translation"]      # an internal stop always falls inside the aligned hit
    if (not has_stop and "A" in examples) or (has_stop and "B" in examples and "C" in examples):
        continue
    called = call_orf(row)
    if called is None:
        continue
    case = classify(called[3])
    if case and case not in examples:
        examples[case] = (i + 1, row, called)
dec.kill()
print(f"Scanned {i:,} rows of {os.path.basename(example_path)}; found case(s) {sorted(examples)}")

# ────────────────────────────────────────── #
# PRINT EACH EXAMPLE THROUGH EVERY 2.1 STEP  #
# ────────────────────────────────────────── #

CASE_TITLES = {
    "A": "A. No internal stop codon",
    "B": f"B. Internal stop codon splits the hit into two valid ORFs (both >= {MIN_ORF_AA} aa)",
    "C": f"C. Internal stop codon splits the hit, only one side is a valid ORF (other < {MIN_ORF_AA} aa)",
}


def show(label, seq):
    print(f"{label} ({len(seq)} aa):")
    print(textwrap.indent("\n".join(textwrap.wrap(seq, WRAP)) or "(empty)", "    "))


def find_written_records(comp, headers):
    """Stream this file's component fastaa until every expected header is found (records are in input order)."""
    path = os.path.join(SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR, f"petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{comp}.fa.zst")
    found, wanted = {}, set(headers)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-dcf", path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1 << 20)
    lines = iter(proc.stdout)
    for header in lines:
        seq = next(lines).rstrip("\n")
        header = header.rstrip("\n")
        if header in wanted:
            found[header] = seq
            if len(found) == len(wanted):
                break
    proc.kill()
    return found


for case in "ABC":
    print("\n" + "═" * 110)
    print(CASE_TITLES[case])
    print("═" * 110)
    if case not in examples:
        print(f"No example found in the first {MAX_SCAN_LINES:,} rows — raise MAX_SCAN_LINES.")
        continue
    line_no, row, (orf, hit_a, hit_b, pieces) = examples[case]

    # ─── 1. RAW .pro ROW ─── #
    print(f"\n1. Raw .pro row (line {line_no:,} of {os.path.basename(example_path)}):")
    for k in PRO_COLUMNS:
        v = row[k]
        if k == "contig":
            v = f"{v[:60]}...{v[-60:]} ({len(v):,} nt)" if len(v) > 130 else v
        elif k == "qseq_translation" and len(v) > 130:
            v = f"{v[:60]}...{v[-60:]} ({len(v)} aa)"
        print(f"    {k:<17}{v}")

    # ─── 2. PARSED HEADER + PARQUET ROW ─── #
    sra, contig_id, kmer = row["qseqid"].split("_", 2)
    sfields = row["sseqid"].split("|")
    subject, comp = sfields[0].rsplit(".", 1)[1], sfields[3]
    print(f"\n2. Parsed: sra_library={sra}  contig={contig_id}  kmer_graph={kmer}  subject_petadex_id={subject}  component_id={comp}")
    parquet_rows = pq.read_table(
        os.path.join(SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET, f"part-{n}.parquet"),
        filters=[("sra_library", "=", sra), ("contig", "=", contig_id),
                 ("subject_petadex_id", "=", subject), ("qstart", "=", int(row["qstart"]))],
    ).to_pandas()
    print("   Parquet row(s):")
    print(textwrap.indent(parquet_rows.to_string(index=False), "    "))

    # ─── 3. STOP-TO-STOP ORF AND SPLIT ─── #
    print(f"\n3. Stop-to-stop ORF (strand {row['qstrand']}): {hit_a} aa upstream extension + "
          f"{hit_b - hit_a} aa DIAMOND hit + {len(orf) - hit_b} aa downstream extension; "
          f"{orf.count('*')} internal stop(s)")
    show("   ORF ('*' = internal stop)", orf)
    for k, pep in enumerate(pieces, 1):
        status = "KEPT" if len(pep) >= MIN_ORF_AA else f"DROPPED (< {MIN_ORF_AA} aa)"
        print(f"   piece {k}: {len(pep):>5} aa  {status}")

    # ─── 4. RECORDS WRITTEN TO THE COMPONENT FASTAA ─── #
    expected = expected_records(row, pieces)
    written = find_written_records(comp, [h for h, _ in expected])
    print(f"\n4. Records in petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{comp}.fa.zst:")
    for header, pep in expected:
        got = written.get(header)
        verdict = "MATCHES re-derived ORF" if got == pep else ("MISSING" if got is None else "DIFFERS from re-derived ORF")
        print(f"   {header}   [{verdict}]")
        show("     sequence", got if got is not None else "")
```

#### 2.1.2. Manual check: search summary statistics
---
Summary statistics of the parsed Logan-DIAMONDx search, computed exactly from the parquet (parts are partitioned by SRA library). Headline counts (including the row-count cross-check), hits per contig, components per contig, hits and contigs per library, top libraries, hits by SRA prefix, contig length, e-value, percent identity, alignment length, a per-component table, and hits per Logan query sequence. Aggregates, tables and plots are saved in `./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/search_summary/`.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #
# MANUAL CHECK: summary statistics of the parsed Logan-DIAMONDx search (2.1).
# The parquet parts are partitioned by SRA library (each library sits in exactly
# one part — asserted below), so every per-contig and per-library statistic is
# computed exactly, one part at a time. A few parts run concurrently on threads
# (polars releases the GIL, and forking after polars has started its thread pool
# can deadlock). Aggregates are cached in QC_DIR so re-running this cell only
# redraws the tables and plots.

import glob, json, os, time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ─── INPUT ─── #
SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/petadex.v260701.logan_query_raw.parquet" # part-{n}.parquet, one row per DIAMONDx hit
DONE_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/done" # 2.1 per-file stats (done.{n}.json)
ROW_COUNTS_TSV = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/logan_diamondx_row_counts.tsv" # from the bash row count before 2.1 (optional)
LOGAN_QUERY = "../s3/5_creating_logan_query/petadex.v260701.logan_query.fastaa" # >petadex_id|hmm_target_start|hmm_target_end|component_id

# ─── OUTPUT ─── #
QC_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/search_summary" # cached aggregates, tables (.tsv) and plots (.png)

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
N_WORKERS = 4                     # parquet parts summarized concurrently (~25 GB RAM each)
HITS_PER_CONTIG_CAP = 200         # contigs with >= this many hits go in the last bin
COMPONENTS_PER_CONTIG_CAP = 46
LENGTH_BINS = np.unique(np.logspace(np.log10(30), np.log10(1_000_000), 120).astype(int))  # contig length (nt), log-spaced
ALN_AA_CAP = 2000                 # alignment length (aa) cap
LOG10_EVALUE_MIN = -320           # e-values are binned by floor(log10); 0 goes in its own count
TOP_N = 20
COLOR = "#4C72B0"

os.makedirs(QC_DIR, exist_ok=True)
CACHE = os.path.join(QC_DIR, "cache")
os.makedirs(CACHE, exist_ok=True)

# ─────────────────────────── #
# SUMMARIZE ONE PARQUET PART  #
# ─────────────────────────── #

def summarize_part(path):
    df = pl.read_parquet(path, columns=["sra_library", "contig", "subject_petadex_id", "component_id",
                                        "qstart", "qend", "qlen", "qstrand", "pident", "evalue"])
    df = df.with_columns(  # categorical / integer keys keep the group-bys at ~25 GB for a 55M-row part
        pl.col("sra_library").cast(pl.Categorical), pl.col("contig").cast(pl.Int64),
        pl.col("component_id").cast(pl.Utf8).cast(pl.Categorical), pl.col("qstrand").cast(pl.Utf8),
        pl.col("subject_petadex_id").cast(pl.Categorical))
    libraries = df["sra_library"].cast(pl.Utf8)
    out = {"part": os.path.basename(path), "n_hits": df.height, "min_library": libraries.min(), "max_library": libraries.max()}

    # ─── PER CONTIG ─── #
    per_contig = df.group_by("sra_library", "contig").agg(
        pl.len().alias("hits"), pl.col("qlen").first(), pl.col("component_id").n_unique().alias("n_components"))
    out["n_contigs"] = per_contig.height
    out["hits_per_contig"] = np.bincount(np.minimum(per_contig["hits"].to_numpy(), HITS_PER_CONTIG_CAP), minlength=HITS_PER_CONTIG_CAP + 1)
    out["components_per_contig"] = np.bincount(np.minimum(per_contig["n_components"].to_numpy(), COMPONENTS_PER_CONTIG_CAP), minlength=COMPONENTS_PER_CONTIG_CAP + 1)
    out["contig_length"] = np.histogram(per_contig["qlen"].to_numpy(), bins=LENGTH_BINS)[0]

    # ─── PER LIBRARY (FULL TABLE, SMALL) ─── #
    out["per_library"] = per_contig.group_by("sra_library").agg(
        pl.col("hits").sum(), pl.len().alias("contigs_with_hits")).with_columns(pl.col("sra_library").cast(pl.Utf8)).to_pandas()

    # ─── PER HIT DISTRIBUTIONS ─── #
    evalue = df["evalue"].to_numpy()
    out["n_evalue_zero"] = int((evalue == 0).sum())
    log_e = np.floor(np.log10(evalue[evalue > 0])).astype(int)
    out["log10_evalue"] = np.bincount(np.clip(log_e, LOG10_EVALUE_MIN, 0) - LOG10_EVALUE_MIN, minlength=-LOG10_EVALUE_MIN + 1)
    out["pident"] = np.bincount(np.clip(np.floor(df["pident"].to_numpy()).astype(int), 0, 100), minlength=101)
    aln_aa = (np.abs(df["qend"].to_numpy() - df["qstart"].to_numpy()) + 1) // 3
    out["aln_aa"] = np.bincount(np.minimum(aln_aa, ALN_AA_CAP), minlength=ALN_AA_CAP + 1)
    strand_counts = df["qstrand"].value_counts()  # one call: value_counts row order is not stable between calls
    out["strand"] = dict(zip(strand_counts["qstrand"].to_list(), strand_counts["count"].to_list()))
    out["library_prefix"] = libraries.str.slice(0, 3).value_counts().to_pandas()

    # ─── PER COMPONENT AND PER QUERY SUBJECT ─── #
    out["per_component"] = df.group_by("component_id", "sra_library", "contig").len().group_by("component_id").agg(
        pl.col("len").sum().alias("hits"),
        pl.len().alias("contigs_with_hits"),
        pl.col("sra_library").n_unique().alias("libraries_with_hits"),
    ).with_columns(pl.col("component_id").cast(pl.Utf8)).to_pandas()
    out["component_pident"] = (df.group_by("component_id", pl.col("pident").floor().cast(pl.Int16).alias("pident_bin")).len()
                               .with_columns(pl.col("component_id").cast(pl.Utf8)).to_pandas())
    out["per_subject"] = (df.group_by("subject_petadex_id").agg(pl.len().alias("hits"))
                          .with_columns(pl.col("subject_petadex_id").cast(pl.Utf8)).to_pandas())
    return out

# ─────────────────────────────────────────── #
# RUN (OR LOAD THE CACHED AGGREGATES)          #
# ─────────────────────────────────────────── #

parts = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(SEARCH_RESULTS_PARQUET, "part-*.parquet")))
cache_npz, cache_json = os.path.join(CACHE, "arrays.npz"), os.path.join(CACHE, "scalars.json")
cache_tables = {k: os.path.join(CACHE, f"{k}.parquet") for k in ("per_library", "per_component", "per_subject", "library_prefix", "component_pident")}

if all(os.path.exists(p) for p in [cache_npz, cache_json, *cache_tables.values()]):
    print(f"Loading cached aggregates from {CACHE} (delete it to recompute)")
    arrays = dict(np.load(cache_npz))
    scalars = json.load(open(cache_json))
    tables = {k: pd.read_parquet(p) for k, p in cache_tables.items()}
else:
    t0 = time.time()
    results = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_WORKERS) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(summarize_part, p) for p in parts]
        for k, fut in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
            results.append(fut.result())
            if k % 10 == 0 or k == len(futures):
                print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] summarized {k}/{len(futures)} parts", flush=True)
    results.sort(key=lambda r: r["part"])

    # libraries never span two parts, so per-contig / per-library counts add up exactly
    for a, b in zip(results, results[1:]):
        assert a["max_library"] < b["min_library"], f"library ranges overlap: {a['part']} / {b['part']}"

    arrays = {k: sum(r[k] for r in results) for k in
              ("hits_per_contig", "components_per_contig", "contig_length", "log10_evalue", "pident", "aln_aa")}
    strand = {}
    for r in results:
        for s, c in r["strand"].items():
            strand[s] = strand.get(s, 0) + c
    scalars = {"n_hits": sum(r["n_hits"] for r in results), "n_contigs": sum(r["n_contigs"] for r in results),
               "n_evalue_zero": sum(r["n_evalue_zero"] for r in results), "strand": strand, "n_parts": len(results)}

    tables = {
        "per_library": pd.concat([r["per_library"] for r in results], ignore_index=True),
        "per_component": pd.concat([r["per_component"] for r in results]).groupby("component_id", as_index=False).sum(),
        "component_pident": pd.concat([r["component_pident"] for r in results]).groupby(["component_id", "pident_bin"], as_index=False)["len"].sum(),
        "per_subject": pd.concat([r["per_subject"] for r in results]).groupby("subject_petadex_id", as_index=False)["hits"].sum(),
        "library_prefix": pd.concat([r["library_prefix"] for r in results]).groupby("sra_library", as_index=False)["count"].sum()
                            .rename(columns={"sra_library": "prefix"}),
    }
    np.savez(cache_npz, **arrays)
    json.dump(scalars, open(cache_json, "w"))
    for k, p in cache_tables.items():
        tables[k].to_parquet(p)
    print(f"Summarized {len(parts)} parts in {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.1f} min")

per_library, per_component, per_subject = tables["per_library"], tables["per_component"], tables["per_subject"]

# ─────────────── #
# PLOTTING HELPERS #
# ─────────────── #

def new_axes(title, xlabel, ylabel, figsize=(8, 4.5)):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.6)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for side in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax


def finish(fig, name):
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(QC_DIR, f"{name}.png"), dpi=200)
    plt.show()


def save_table(df, name):
    df.to_csv(os.path.join(QC_DIR, f"{name}.tsv"), sep="\t", index=False)
    display(df)


def log_bins(values, n=60):
    hi = max(int(values.max()), 2)
    return np.unique(np.logspace(0, np.log10(hi + 1), n).astype(int))

# ──────────────────── #
# 1. HEADLINE NUMBERS   #
# ──────────────────── #
done = [json.load(open(f)) for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DONE_DIR, "done.*.json")))]
query_ids = {line[1:].split("|", 1)[0] for line in open(LOGAN_QUERY) if line.startswith(">")}
pro_rows = None
if os.path.exists(ROW_COUNTS_TSV):
    pro_rows = int(pd.read_csv(ROW_COUNTS_TSV, sep="\t", header=None, names=["file", "rows"]).set_index("file").loc["TOTAL", "rows"])

headline = pd.DataFrame([
    ("DIAMONDx rows in the .pro.zst files (bash count)", f"{pro_rows:,}" if pro_rows is not None else "run the bash row count cell"),
    ("DIAMONDx rows parsed by 2.1 (done.*.json)", f"{sum(d['rows'] for d in done):,}"),
    ("hits in the parquet", f"{scalars['n_hits']:,}"),
    ("unique SRA libraries with a hit", f"{len(per_library):,}"),
    ("unique contigs with a hit", f"{scalars['n_contigs']:,}"),
    ("mean hits per contig", f"{scalars['n_hits'] / scalars['n_contigs']:.2f}"),
    ("contigs with > 1 hit", f"{int(arrays['hits_per_contig'][2:].sum()):,}"),
    ("mean hits per library", f"{scalars['n_hits'] / len(per_library):,.1f}"),
    ("mean contigs with a hit per library", f"{scalars['n_contigs'] / len(per_library):,.1f}"),
    ("Logan query sequences with >= 1 hit", f"{per_subject['subject_petadex_id'].isin(query_ids).sum():,} / {len(query_ids):,}"),
    ("hits on + / - strand", " / ".join(f"{scalars['strand'].get(s, 0):,}" for s in "+-")),
    ("hits with e-value reported as 0", f"{scalars['n_evalue_zero']:,}"),
    ("ORFs written to component fastaas", f"{sum(sum(d['n_orfs'].values()) for d in done):,}"),
    ("hits split by an internal stop codon", f"{sum(d['split_hits'] for d in done):,}"),
    (f"ORF pieces dropped (< 30 aa)", f"{sum(d['short_piece_dropped'] for d in done):,}"),
    ("hits whose ORF frame could not be found", f"{sum(d['frame_mismatch'] for d in done):,}"),
], columns=["statistic", "value"])
if pro_rows is not None:
    assert pro_rows == sum(d["rows"] for d in done) == scalars["n_hits"], "row counts disagree between the .pro files, 2.1 and the parquet"
save_table(headline, "headline")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 2. HITS PER CONTIG         #
# ───────────────────────── #
h = arrays["hits_per_contig"]
fig, ax = new_axes(f"Hits per contig ({scalars['n_contigs']:,} contigs)", f"DIAMONDx hits on the contig (last bar = {HITS_PER_CONTIG_CAP}+)", "contigs")
ax.bar(np.arange(1, len(h)), h[1:], width=1.0, color=COLOR)
ax.set_yscale("log")
finish(fig, "hits_per_contig")

c = arrays["components_per_contig"]
fig, ax = new_axes("Distinct components hit per contig", "components with a hit on the contig", "contigs")
ax.bar(np.arange(1, len(c)), c[1:], width=0.8, color=COLOR)
ax.set_yscale("log")
finish(fig, "components_per_contig")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 3. PER LIBRARY             #
# ───────────────────────── #
for col, label in (("hits", "DIAMONDx hits in the library"), ("contigs_with_hits", "contigs with a hit in the library")):
    v = per_library[col].to_numpy()
    fig, ax = new_axes(f"{label[0].upper() + label[1:]} ({len(v):,} libraries)", label, "libraries")
    ax.hist(v, bins=log_bins(v), color=COLOR)
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    finish(fig, f"{col}_per_library")

save_table(per_library.sort_values("hits", ascending=False).head(TOP_N).reset_index(drop=True), "top_libraries_by_hits")
save_table(tables["library_prefix"].sort_values("count", ascending=False).rename(columns={"count": "hits"}), "hits_by_library_prefix")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 4. CONTIG LENGTH           #
# ───────────────────────── #
fig, ax = new_axes("Length of contigs with a hit (one count per contig)", "contig length (nt)", "contigs")
ax.stairs(arrays["contig_length"], LENGTH_BINS, fill=True, color=COLOR)
ax.set_xscale("log")
finish(fig, "contig_length_per_contig")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 5. E-VALUE, PID, ALN LENGTH #
# ───────────────────────── #
e = arrays["log10_evalue"]
nz = np.nonzero(e)[0]
x = np.arange(LOG10_EVALUE_MIN, 1)
fig, ax = new_axes(f"DIAMONDx e-value ({scalars['n_evalue_zero']:,} hits at e = 0 not shown)", "floor(log10 e-value)", "hits")
ax.bar(x[nz.min():nz.max() + 1], e[nz.min():nz.max() + 1], width=1.0, color=COLOR)
ax.set_yscale("log")
finish(fig, "evalue_hist")

p = arrays["pident"]
fig, ax = new_axes("DIAMONDx percent identity", "pident (%)", "hits")
ax.bar(np.arange(101), p, width=1.0, color=COLOR)
finish(fig, "pident_hist")

a = arrays["aln_aa"]
fig, ax = new_axes("DIAMONDx alignment length on the contig", f"alignment length (aa, last bar = {ALN_AA_CAP}+)", "hits")
ax.bar(np.arange(len(a)), a, width=1.0, color=COLOR)
ax.set_yscale("log")
finish(fig, "alignment_length_hist")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 6. PER COMPONENT           #
# ───────────────────────── #
orfs = pd.DataFrame([{"component_id": c, "orfs_written": n} for d in done for c, n in d["n_orfs"].items()]).groupby("component_id", as_index=False).sum()
per_component = per_component.merge(orfs, on="component_id", how="left").sort_values("component_id").reset_index(drop=True)
per_component["hits_per_contig"] = per_component["hits"] / per_component["contigs_with_hits"]

def binned_median(g):  # median pident from the per-component 1%-bin histogram (lower bin edge)
    g = g.sort_values("pident_bin")
    return int(g["pident_bin"].to_numpy()[np.searchsorted(g["len"].cumsum().to_numpy(), g["len"].sum() / 2)])

per_component["median_pident"] = per_component["component_id"].map(
    tables["component_pident"].groupby("component_id")[["pident_bin", "len"]].apply(binned_median))
save_table(per_component[["component_id", "hits", "contigs_with_hits", "libraries_with_hits", "hits_per_contig",
                          "orfs_written", "median_pident"]], "per_component")

fig, ax = new_axes("DIAMONDx hits per component", "component", "hits", figsize=(12, 4.5))
ax.bar(per_component["component_id"], per_component["hits"], color=COLOR)
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90, labelsize=8)
finish(fig, "hits_per_component")

# ───────────────────────── #
# 7. PER LOGAN QUERY SUBJECT #
# ───────────────────────── #
v = per_subject["hits"].to_numpy()
fig, ax = new_axes(f"Hits per Logan query sequence ({len(v):,} of {len(query_ids):,} query sequences hit)", "DIAMONDx hits to the query sequence", "query sequences")
ax.hist(v, bins=log_bins(v), color=COLOR)
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set_yscale("log")
finish(fig, "hits_per_query_subject")
save_table(per_subject.sort_values("hits", ascending=False).head(TOP_N).reset_index(drop=True), "top_query_subjects_by_hits")
```

#### 2.1.3. Manual check: ORF length
---
Amino-acid length of every ORF piece 2.1 wrote to the component fastaas (after the stop-to-stop extension, splitting on internal stops and dropping pieces &lt; 30 aa), overall and per component. Saved in `./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/orf_length/`.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #
# MANUAL CHECK: amino-acid length of every ORF piece 2.1 wrote to the component
# fastaas (after stop-to-stop extension, splitting on internal stops and dropping
# pieces < MIN_ORF_AA). Counted per component; cached in QC_DIR.

import glob, json, os, re, subprocess, time
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import multiprocessing as mp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ─── INPUT ─── #
SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/component_fastaas" # petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa.zst

# ─── OUTPUT ─── #
QC_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/orf_length" # cached per-component length counts, table and plots

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
N_WORKERS = 64        # fastaas counted in parallel (each runs one zstd -dc)
LENGTH_CAP = 3000     # ORFs >= this many aa go in the last bin
MIN_ORF_AA = 30       # must match 2.1 (sanity check: nothing shorter should exist)
COLOR = "#4C72B0"

os.makedirs(QC_DIR, exist_ok=True)
CACHE = os.path.join(QC_DIR, "orf_length_counts.npz")

# ───────────────────── #
# COUNT ORF LENGTHS      #
# ───────────────────── #

def count_lengths(path):
    """Bincount of sequence-line lengths (one sequence line per record in 2.1's output)."""
    counts = np.zeros(LENGTH_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    lengths = []
    proc = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-dcf", path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=1 << 24)
    for k, line in enumerate(proc.stdout):
        if k % 2:
            lengths.append(len(line) - 1)
            if len(lengths) >= 1_000_000:
                counts += np.bincount(np.minimum(lengths, LENGTH_CAP), minlength=LENGTH_CAP + 1)
                lengths.clear()
    if lengths:
        counts += np.bincount(np.minimum(lengths, LENGTH_CAP), minlength=LENGTH_CAP + 1)
    if proc.wait() != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"zstd -dc failed on {path}")
    return re.search(r"\.(C\d+)\.fa\.zst$", path).group(1), counts


if os.path.exists(CACHE):
    print(f"Loading cached counts from {CACHE} (delete it to recount)")
    per_component = dict(np.load(CACHE))
else:
    t0 = time.time()
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR, "petadex-logan.hits.*.fa.zst")), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)
    per_component = {}
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_WORKERS, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(count_lengths, p) for p in paths]
        for k, fut in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
            comp, counts = fut.result()
            per_component[comp] = per_component.get(comp, 0) + counts
            if k % 500 == 0 or k == len(futures):
                print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] counted {k}/{len(futures)} fastaas", flush=True)
    np.savez(CACHE, **per_component)
    print(f"Counted {len(paths)} fastaas in {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.1f} min")

# ───────────────── #
# SUMMARY TABLE      #
# ───────────────── #
lengths = np.arange(LENGTH_CAP + 1)

def quantile(counts, q):
    return int(lengths[np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(counts), q * counts.sum())])

rows = []
for comp in sorted(per_component):
    c = per_component[comp]
    rows.append({"component_id": comp, "orfs": int(c.sum()), "min_aa": int(lengths[c > 0].min()),
                 "q25_aa": quantile(c, 0.25), "median_aa": quantile(c, 0.5), "q75_aa": quantile(c, 0.75),
                 "mean_aa": round(float((lengths * c).sum() / c.sum()), 1), f"orfs_>={LENGTH_CAP}_aa": int(c[-1])})
total = sum(per_component.values())
summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
summary.loc[len(summary)] = {"component_id": "TOTAL", "orfs": int(total.sum()), "min_aa": int(lengths[total > 0].min()),
                             "q25_aa": quantile(total, 0.25), "median_aa": quantile(total, 0.5), "q75_aa": quantile(total, 0.75),
                             "mean_aa": round(float((lengths * total).sum() / total.sum()), 1), f"orfs_>={LENGTH_CAP}_aa": int(total[-1])}
assert int(lengths[total > 0].min()) >= MIN_ORF_AA, "an ORF shorter than MIN_ORF_AA was written"
summary.to_csv(os.path.join(QC_DIR, "orf_length_per_component.tsv"), sep="\t", index=False)
display(summary)

# ───────────────── #
# HISTOGRAMS         #
# ───────────────── #
def new_axes(title, xlabel, ylabel):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.6)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for side in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
    return fig, ax

for yscale in ("linear", "log"):
    fig, ax = new_axes(f"ORF length, all components ({int(total.sum()):,} ORFs)", f"ORF length (aa, last bar = {LENGTH_CAP}+)", "ORFs")
    ax.bar(lengths, total, width=1.0, color=COLOR)
    ax.axvline(MIN_ORF_AA, color="#555555", linewidth=1, linestyle="--")
    ax.text(MIN_ORF_AA, ax.get_ylim()[1], f" {MIN_ORF_AA} aa minimum", va="top", fontsize=8, color="#555555")
    ax.set_yscale(yscale)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(QC_DIR, f"orf_length_hist_{yscale}.png"), dpi=200)
    plt.show()

# per-component medians with interquartile range
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 4.5))
s = summary[summary["component_id"] != "TOTAL"]
ax.vlines(s["component_id"], s["q25_aa"], s["q75_aa"], color=COLOR, linewidth=2)
ax.plot(s["component_id"], s["median_aa"], "o", color=COLOR, markersize=5)
ax.set_title("ORF length per component (dot = median, line = 25th–75th percentile)")
ax.set_xlabel("component")
ax.set_ylabel("ORF length (aa)")
ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90, labelsize=8)
for side in ("top", "right"):
    ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(os.path.join(QC_DIR, "orf_length_per_component.png"), dpi=200)
plt.show()
```

### 2.2. Deduplicate the ORFs
---
NCBI nr is inherently 100% clustered, and so for the Logan results, I will 100% cluster them. To do this, this section will:
- Get all the sequences per a component, deduplicate through 100% string matching, then shard the deduplicated sequences into 100 fastaas. 
- Remove any hit that is above the e-value cut-off of 1.0E-5.
- For the header, the lowest e-value hit of the duplicate ORFs is taken as the first accession, then the rest are listed afterwards. 
- For the TSV header, the second value in each field will be the extra accessions information.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #

import collections, glob, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time, zlib
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import multiprocessing as mp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ─── INPUT ─── #
SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/component_fastaas" # 100 per component petadex-logan.hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa

# ─── WORKING ─── #
PARTITION_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/dedup_partition" # {component_id}/{n}/b{shard}.tsv, removed once every shard is deduplicated
DEDUP_DONE_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/dedup_done" # restart markers + per-task stats

# ─── OUTPUT ─── #
DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/dudplicated_component_fastaas" # 100 per component petadex-logan.significant-hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa
"""Format (each field lists the lowest e-value hit first, then the duplicates in ascending e-value):
>{acc_1},{acc_2},...|{evalue_1},{evalue_2},...|{pid_1},{pid_2},...|{subject_petadex_id_1},{subject_petadex_id_2},...|{component_id}
{translated_orf_aa_seq}
"""
OUTPUT_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/output"

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
EVALUE_CUTOFF = 1e-5          # drop hits with an e-value above this
N_SHARDS = 100                # output fastaas per component (sequence -> shard by crc32, so duplicates always share a shard)
N_PARTITION_WORKERS = 100     # one streaming worker per input .fa.zst
N_DEDUP_WORKERS = 48          # one worker per (component, shard); largest shard holds ~10M records in memory
WRITE_BUFFER = 1 << 20
TEST_COMPONENT = None         # set to e.g. "C027" to run both phases on a single component

for d in (PARTITION_DIR, DEDUP_DONE_DIR, DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR):
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)

# ───────────────────── #
# DEDUPLICATE SEQUENCES #
# ───────────────────── #

def partition_file(path, n, comp):
    """Stream one component fastaa, drop non-significant hits and route each record to its shard by sequence hash."""
    t0 = time.time()
    final = os.path.join(PARTITION_DIR, comp, n)
    tmp = final + ".tmp"
    for d in (tmp, final):
        shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(tmp)
    outs = [open(os.path.join(tmp, f"b{b:05d}.tsv"), "wb", buffering=WRITE_BUFFER) for b in range(N_SHARDS)]
    stats = {"comp": comp, "file": n, "n_in": 0, "n_evalue_dropped": 0, "n_pass": 0}

    dec = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-dcq", path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=1 << 24)
    lines = iter(dec.stdout)
    for header in lines:
        seq = next(lines).rstrip(b"\n")
        acc, evalue, pident, subject, _comp = header[1:].rstrip(b"\n").rsplit(b"|", 4)
        stats["n_in"] += 1
        if float(evalue) > EVALUE_CUTOFF:
            stats["n_evalue_dropped"] += 1
            continue
        outs[zlib.crc32(seq) % N_SHARDS].write(b"\t".join((seq, acc, evalue, pident, subject)) + b"\n")
        stats["n_pass"] += 1
    if dec.wait() != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"zstd -dc failed on {path}")
    for fh in outs:
        fh.close()

    os.replace(tmp, final)
    stats["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    with open(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, f"partition.{comp}.{n}.json"), "w") as fh:
        json.dump(stats, fh)
    return stats


def dedup_shard(comp, shard):
    """Collapse identical sequences of one (component, shard) and write the deduplicated fastaa."""
    t0 = time.time()
    fname = f"b{shard:05d}.tsv"
    parts = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(PARTITION_DIR, comp, "[0-9]" * 5, fname)))

    # ─── GROUP BY SEQUENCE: seq -> {acc: (evalue, raw_evalue, pident, subject)} ─── #
    # same accession + identical sequence -> keep the lowest e-value entry;
    # same accession with a different sequence lands in another group and is kept
    groups = {}
    n_records = 0
    for part in parts:
        with open(part, "rb") as fh:
            for line in fh:
                seq, acc, evalue, pident, subject = line.rstrip(b"\n").split(b"\t")
                ev = float(evalue)
                n_records += 1
                g = groups.get(seq)
                if g is None:
                    groups[seq] = {acc: (ev, evalue, pident, subject)}
                else:
                    cur = g.get(acc)
                    if cur is None or ev < cur[0]:
                        g[acc] = (ev, evalue, pident, subject)

    # ─── WRITE DEDUPLICATED FASTAA (lowest e-value hit first) ─── #
    name = f"petadex-logan.significant-hits.{shard:05d}.{comp}.fa"
    out = os.path.join(DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR, name)
    tail = b"|" + comp.encode() + b"\n"
    copies = collections.Counter()
    with open(out + ".tmp", "wb", buffering=4 * WRITE_BUFFER) as fh:
        for seq, g in groups.items():
            hits = sorted(g.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[1][0], -float(kv[1][2]), kv[0]))
            copies[len(hits)] += 1
            fh.write(b">" + b",".join(acc for acc, _ in hits)
                     + b"|" + b",".join(h[1] for _, h in hits)
                     + b"|" + b",".join(h[2] for _, h in hits)
                     + b"|" + b",".join(h[3] for _, h in hits)
                     + tail + seq + b"\n")
    os.replace(out + ".tmp", out)

    stats = {"comp": comp, "shard": shard, "n_records": n_records, "n_unique": len(groups),
             "n_hits_kept": sum(k * v for k, v in copies.items()),
             "max_copies": max(copies, default=0), "copies": copies, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}
    with open(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, f"dedup.{comp}.{shard:05d}.json"), "w") as fh:
        json.dump(stats, fh)
    for part in parts:
        os.remove(part)
    return stats


# ─── PHASE A: PARTITION EVERY INPUT FILE BY SEQUENCE HASH, LARGEST FIRST ─── #
input_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(SEARCH_FASTAA_DIR, "petadex-logan.hits.*.fa.zst")), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)
file_key = lambda p: re.search(r"\.hits\.(\d+)\.(C\d+)\.fa\.zst$", p).groups() # (n, comp)
if TEST_COMPONENT:
    input_files = [p for p in input_files if file_key(p)[1] == TEST_COMPONENT]
components = sorted({file_key(p)[1] for p in input_files})

todo = [p for p in input_files if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, "partition.{1}.{0}.json".format(*file_key(p))))]
print(f"Partition: {len(input_files) - len(todo)} files already done, {len(todo)} to run with {N_PARTITION_WORKERS} workers")
with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_PARTITION_WORKERS, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as pool:
    futures = [pool.submit(partition_file, p, *file_key(p)) for p in todo]
    for k, fut in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
        res = fut.result()
        if k % 100 == 0 or k == len(futures):
            print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] partitioned {k}/{len(futures)} (last {res['comp']}.{res['file']}: "
                  f"{res['n_pass']:,}/{res['n_in']:,} pass in {res['seconds']/60:.1f} min)", flush=True)

# ─── PHASE B: DEDUPLICATE EACH (COMPONENT, SHARD), LARGEST COMPONENT FIRST ─── #
partition_stats = [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, "partition.*.json"))]
partition_stats = [s for s in partition_stats if s["comp"] in components]
comp_pass = collections.Counter()
for s in partition_stats:
    comp_pass[s["comp"]] += s["n_pass"]

tasks = [(c, b) for c in sorted(components, key=comp_pass.__getitem__, reverse=True) for b in range(N_SHARDS)
         if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, f"dedup.{c}.{b:05d}.json"))]
print(f"Deduplicate: {len(components) * N_SHARDS - len(tasks)} shards already done, {len(tasks)} to run with {N_DEDUP_WORKERS} workers")
with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_DEDUP_WORKERS, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as pool:
    futures = [pool.submit(dedup_shard, c, b) for c, b in tasks]
    for k, fut in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
        res = fut.result()
        if k % 100 == 0 or k == len(futures):
            print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] deduplicated {k}/{len(futures)} (last {res['comp']}.{res['shard']:05d}: "
                  f"{res['n_records']:,} -> {res['n_unique']:,} in {res['seconds']/60:.1f} min)", flush=True)

for c in components:
    shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(PARTITION_DIR, c), ignore_errors=True)

# ─────────────────────── #
# SUMMARY OF DEDUPLICATES #
# ─────────────────────── #
dedup_stats = [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(DEDUP_DONE_DIR, "dedup.*.json"))]
dedup_stats = [s for s in dedup_stats if s["comp"] in components]

# ─── TABLE OF ORFS IN vs. UNIQUE SEQUENCES OUT PER COMPONENT ─── #
summary = pd.DataFrame(partition_stats).groupby("comp")[["n_in", "n_evalue_dropped", "n_pass"]].sum().join(
    pd.DataFrame(dedup_stats).groupby("comp").agg(n_hits_kept=("n_hits_kept", "sum"), n_unique=("n_unique", "sum"), max_copies=("max_copies", "max")))
summary.index.name = "component_id"
summary.loc["TOTAL"] = summary.sum()
summary.loc["TOTAL", "max_copies"] = summary["max_copies"].iloc[:-1].max()
summary["dedup_ratio"] = summary["n_pass"] / summary["n_unique"]
summary.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "logan_dedup_component_summary.tsv"), sep="\t")
display(summary)

# ─── HISTOGRAM OF COPIES PER UNIQUE SEQUENCE ─── #
copies = collections.Counter()
for s in dedup_stats:
    copies.update({int(k): v for k, v in s["copies"].items()})
n_copies = np.array(sorted(copies))
n_seqs = np.array([copies[k] for k in n_copies])
bins = np.logspace(0, np.log10(n_copies.max() + 1), 60)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
ax.hist(n_copies, bins=bins, weights=n_seqs, color="#4C72B0")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("Hits collapsed into one unique ORF")
ax.set_ylabel("Unique ORFs")
ax.set_title(f"Logan ORF duplication ({n_seqs.sum():,} unique ORFs from {int((n_copies * n_seqs).sum()):,} hits)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "logan_dedup_copy_number_hist.png"), dpi=200)
plt.show()
```

#### 2.2.1. Manual check: deduplicated records
---
Example records that 2.2 collapsed, then, for every non-primary accession (a duplicate folded into the record's lowest e-value hit), whether it came from the same contig or the same SRA library as the primary accession, and how many distinct contigs and libraries the non-primary accessions come from. Saved in `./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/dedup/`.


```python
# ───────────── #
# SCRIPT SET UP #
# ───────────── #
# MANUAL CHECK: what 2.2's 100%-identity deduplication collapsed.
#   1. Example deduplicated records (header fields truncated to a few entries).
#   2. For every non-primary accession (2nd, 3rd, ... entry of a header — the
#      duplicates folded into the lowest e-value hit), whether it comes from the
#      same contig / same SRA library as that record's primary accession, and how
#      many distinct contigs and libraries the non-primary accessions come from.
# Accession = {sra_library}_{contig}_{kmer_graph}[.{piece}] (piece only for ORFs
# split on an internal stop), so a contig is (sra_library, contig).

import collections, glob, json, os, re, time
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
import multiprocessing as mp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ─── INPUT ─── #
DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/working/dudplicated_component_fastaas" # petadex-logan.significant-hits.{n}.{component_id}.fa
"""Format (each field lists the lowest e-value hit first, then the duplicates in ascending e-value):
>{acc_1},{acc_2},...|{evalue_1},{evalue_2},...|{pid_1},{pid_2},...|{subject_petadex_id_1},...|{component_id}
"""

# ─── OUTPUT ─── #
QC_DIR = "./6_logan_search_qc/output/qc/dedup" # cached counts, tables and plots

# ─── PARAMETERS ─── #
EXAMPLE_COMPONENT = "C007"         # its shards are scanned in order for the example records (C007 has the highest duplication)
EXAMPLE_MAX_RECORDS = 20_000_000   # stop looking for examples after this many records
N_WORKERS = 64            # shards scanned in parallel
GROUP_SIZE_CAP = 100_000  # bincount cap for accessions per record / libraries per record
SHOW_ENTRIES = 4          # entries shown per header field in the examples
COLOR = "#4C72B0"

os.makedirs(QC_DIR, exist_ok=True)
CACHE_JSON, CACHE_NPZ = os.path.join(QC_DIR, "dedup_counts.json"), os.path.join(QC_DIR, "dedup_counts.npz")
SRA_PREFIX = {"DRR": 0, "ERR": 1, "SRR": 2}

# ─────────────── #
# PARSE HELPERS    #
# ─────────────── #

def library_and_contig(acc):
    first = acc.index("_")
    return acc[:first], acc[first + 1:acc.index("_", first + 1)]


def library_key(library):
    # 2 bits of prefix + 28 bits of run number -> one int, so millions of libraries fit in a numpy array
    return (SRA_PREFIX[library[:3]] << 28) | int(library[3:])


def contig_key(library, contig):
    return (library_key(library) << 32) | int(contig)

# ──────────────────────── #
# 1. EXAMPLE RECORDS        #
# ──────────────────────── #

def truncated(field):
    items = field.split(",")
    shown = ",".join(items[:SHOW_ENTRIES])
    return shown + (f",... (+{len(items) - SHOW_ENTRIES:,} more)" if len(items) > SHOW_ENTRIES else "")


def print_record(title, header, seq):
    fields = header[1:].split("|")
    accs = fields[0].split(",")
    libraries = {library_and_contig(a)[0] for a in accs}
    contigs = {library_and_contig(a) for a in accs}
    print("\n" + "─" * 110)
    print(f"{title}: {len(accs):,} accessions from {len(contigs):,} contig(s) in {len(libraries):,} library(ies)")
    print("─" * 110)
    for name, field in zip(["accessions", "evalues", "pids", "subjects", "component"], fields):
        print(f"    {name:<11}{truncated(field)}")
    print(f"    sequence   {seq[:100]}{'...' if len(seq) > 100 else ''} ({len(seq)} aa)")


wanted = {
    "Two accessions from different libraries": lambda accs, libs, contigs: len(accs) == 2 and len(libs) == 2,
    "Duplicates from one library (different contigs)": lambda accs, libs, contigs: len(libs) == 1 and len(contigs) == len(accs),
}
examples, largest, n_scanned = {}, (0, None, None, None), 0
for shard_path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR, f"petadex-logan.significant-hits.*.{EXAMPLE_COMPONENT}.fa"))):
    with open(shard_path) as fh:
        for header in fh:
            seq = next(fh).rstrip("\n")
            n_scanned += 1
            accs = header[1:header.index("|")].split(",")
            if len(accs) > largest[0]:
                largest = (len(accs), header.rstrip("\n"), seq, os.path.basename(shard_path))
            if len(accs) > 1:
                parsed = [library_and_contig(a) for a in accs]
                libs, contigs = {p[0] for p in parsed}, set(parsed)
                for title, test in wanted.items():
                    if title not in examples and test(accs, libs, contigs):
                        examples[title] = (header.rstrip("\n"), seq, os.path.basename(shard_path))
            if n_scanned >= EXAMPLE_MAX_RECORDS:
                break
    if len(examples) == len(wanted) or n_scanned >= EXAMPLE_MAX_RECORDS:
        break
print(f"Example records from {EXAMPLE_COMPONENT} shards ({n_scanned:,} records scanned):")
for title in wanted:
    if title in examples:
        header, seq, shard = examples[title]
        print_record(f"{title} [{shard}]", header, seq)
    else:
        print(f"\n(no '{title}' record in the first {n_scanned:,} {EXAMPLE_COMPONENT} records)")
print_record(f"Largest duplicate group among the scanned records [{largest[3]}]", largest[1], largest[2])

# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #
# 2. NON-PRIMARY ACCESSIONS ACROSS EVERY SHARD  #
# ──────────────────────────────────────────── #

def scan_shard(path):
    c = collections.Counter()
    group_size = np.zeros(GROUP_SIZE_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    libraries_per_group = np.zeros(GROUP_SIZE_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    nonprimary_contigs, nonprimary_libraries = [], set()
    with open(path) as fh:
        for k, line in enumerate(fh):
            if k % 2:
                continue
            accs = line[1:line.index("|")].split(",")
            c["records"] += 1
            group_size[min(len(accs), GROUP_SIZE_CAP)] += 1
            if len(accs) == 1:
                continue
            c["records_with_duplicates"] += 1
            primary_library, primary_contig = library_and_contig(accs[0])
            libraries = {primary_library}
            for acc in accs[1:]:
                library, contig = library_and_contig(acc)
                c["nonprimary"] += 1
                c["nonprimary_same_library_as_primary"] += library == primary_library
                c["nonprimary_same_contig_as_primary"] += library == primary_library and contig == primary_contig
                libraries.add(library)
                nonprimary_libraries.add(library)
                nonprimary_contigs.append(contig_key(library, contig))
            libraries_per_group[min(len(libraries), GROUP_SIZE_CAP)] += 1
            c["records_spanning_multiple_libraries"] += len(libraries) > 1
    return (dict(c), group_size, libraries_per_group,
            np.unique(np.array(nonprimary_contigs, dtype=np.int64)),
            np.array(sorted(library_key(l) for l in nonprimary_libraries), dtype=np.int64))


if os.path.exists(CACHE_JSON) and os.path.exists(CACHE_NPZ):
    print(f"\nLoading cached counts from {QC_DIR} (delete {os.path.basename(CACHE_JSON)} to rescan)")
    counts = json.load(open(CACHE_JSON))
    arrays = dict(np.load(CACHE_NPZ))
else:
    t0 = time.time()
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR, "petadex-logan.significant-hits.*.fa")), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)
    totals, per_component = collections.Counter(), collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    group_size = np.zeros(GROUP_SIZE_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    libraries_per_group = np.zeros(GROUP_SIZE_CAP + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    contig_chunks, library_chunks = [], []
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=N_WORKERS, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as pool:
        futures = {pool.submit(scan_shard, p): p for p in paths}
        for k, fut in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
            c, gs, lpg, contigs, libraries = fut.result()
            comp = re.search(r"\.(C\d+)\.fa$", futures[fut]).group(1)
            totals.update(c)
            per_component[comp].update(c)
            group_size += gs
            libraries_per_group += lpg
            contig_chunks.append(contigs)
            library_chunks.append(libraries)
            if k % 500 == 0 or k == len(futures):
                print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] scanned {k}/{len(futures)} shards", flush=True)
    # a contig can be non-primary in several shards (e.g. its split pieces), so take the global unique
    totals["distinct_nonprimary_contigs"] = int(np.unique(np.concatenate(contig_chunks)).size)
    del contig_chunks
    totals["distinct_nonprimary_libraries"] = int(np.unique(np.concatenate(library_chunks)).size)
    counts = {"totals": dict(totals), "per_component": {k: dict(v) for k, v in per_component.items()}}
    arrays = {"group_size": group_size, "libraries_per_group": libraries_per_group}
    json.dump(counts, open(CACHE_JSON, "w"))
    np.savez(CACHE_NPZ, **arrays)
    print(f"Scanned {len(paths)} shards in {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.1f} min")

t = counts["totals"]
summary = pd.DataFrame([
    ("unique ORFs (records)", t["records"]),
    ("records with >= 1 duplicate", t["records_with_duplicates"]),
    ("non-primary accessions (duplicates folded into a record)", t["nonprimary"]),
    ("  ... from the same contig as the primary (split pieces)", t["nonprimary_same_contig_as_primary"]),
    ("  ... from a different contig, same library as the primary", t["nonprimary_same_library_as_primary"] - t["nonprimary_same_contig_as_primary"]),
    ("  ... from a different library than the primary", t["nonprimary"] - t["nonprimary_same_library_as_primary"]),
    ("distinct contigs the non-primary accessions come from", t["distinct_nonprimary_contigs"]),
    ("distinct libraries the non-primary accessions come from", t["distinct_nonprimary_libraries"]),
    ("records whose accessions span > 1 library", t["records_spanning_multiple_libraries"]),
], columns=["statistic", "count"])
summary["% of non-primary"] = [""] * 2 + ["100.00"] + [f"{100 * v / t['nonprimary']:.2f}" for v in summary["count"][3:6]] + [""] * 3
summary.to_csv(os.path.join(QC_DIR, "dedup_summary.tsv"), sep="\t", index=False)
display(summary.assign(count=summary["count"].map("{:,}".format)))

per_component = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(counts["per_component"], orient="index").fillna(0).astype(int).sort_index()
per_component["dedup_ratio"] = (per_component["records"] + per_component["nonprimary"]) / per_component["records"]
per_component["%_nonprimary_other_library"] = 100 * (per_component["nonprimary"] - per_component["nonprimary_same_library_as_primary"]) / per_component["nonprimary"].clip(lower=1)
per_component.index.name = "component_id"
per_component.to_csv(os.path.join(QC_DIR, "dedup_per_component.tsv"), sep="\t")
display(per_component[["records", "records_with_duplicates", "nonprimary", "nonprimary_same_contig_as_primary",
                       "nonprimary_same_library_as_primary", "records_spanning_multiple_libraries", "dedup_ratio",
                       "%_nonprimary_other_library"]].round(2))

# ─── HISTOGRAMS: ACCESSIONS AND LIBRARIES PER RECORD ─── #
for name, label in (("group_size", "accessions collapsed into the record"), ("libraries_per_group", "distinct libraries among the record's accessions")):
    v = arrays[name]
    x = np.nonzero(v)[0]
    x = x[x >= 1]
    bins = np.unique(np.logspace(0, np.log10(x.max() + 1), 60).astype(int))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    ax.hist(x, bins=bins, weights=v[x], color=COLOR)
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.set_title(f"{label[0].upper() + label[1:]} (records with duplicates only)" if name == "libraries_per_group" else f"{label[0].upper() + label[1:]}")
    ax.set_xlabel(label + (f" (last bin = {GROUP_SIZE_CAP:,}+)" if v[-1] else ""))
    ax.set_ylabel("records")
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.6)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for side in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(QC_DIR, f"{name}_hist.png"), dpi=200)
    plt.show()
```

### 2.3. Obtain all Logan-DIAMONDx hits that contain an HMM hit
---
This section will search the PETadex-HMMs against the Logan-DIAMONDx results obtained by Rayan. There is 100 fastaas per component, so all of the 4600 fastaas must be ran in parallel. The script will set a queue through these 4600 files, and run them in parallel 40 at a time.

This will produce the following information:
1. Which sequences have an HMM hit below the e-value cutoff. If sequence has a significant hit (&lt;1.0E-05), then assign it a "petadex_id" that follows the format of "LG\{integer, ascending from 1\}.
2. The range where the HMM hit to. The hmm_start and hmm_end values will be columns in a csv called "petadex-logan.v260701.catalytic_domain_annotations.csv".
3. The identity of the amino acids in the catalytic residue of the HMM-hit sequences. The identity and amino acid position will be columns in "petadex-logan.v260701.catalytic_domain_annotations.csv".
4. If the sequence is a complete (contains a residue in all catalytic positions) or partial (not all the catalytic sites were aligned to). This will be held as a boolean in the table "petadex-logan.v260701.catalytic_domain_annotations.csv".

The pipeline of the following scripts is the following:
1. HMMalign the annotations to the HMMs
2. HMMsearch the HMMs against their component fastaas
3. Parse the results to output all sequences with a hit below the e-value cutoff.
4. For each significant hit, output the annotations for the sequence (information mentioned above).


```bash
%%bash

# ────────────────────── #
# HMMSEARCH THE LOGAN HITS  #
# ────────────────────── #
MASTER_DIRECTORY="./6_logan_search_qc/working/hmmsearch"

# ─── INPUT  ─── #
DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR="./6_logan_search_qc/working/dudplicated_component_fastaas" # 100 per component
PLASTICOME_HMMS="../s3/4_hmm_creation/petadex_hmms" # file format petadex.v260701-{sub_component_id}.hmm
ANNOTATIONS="../s3/3_msa_cleaning/plasticome.v2.sequence_annotations.csv"

# ─── OUTPUT  ─── #
PETADEX_LOGAN_HMM_ANNOTATIONS="../s3/6_logan_search_qc/petadex-logan.v260701.catalytic_domain_annotations.csv" # every hit below e-value cutoff
# column format:
# petadex_id,component_id,hmm_name,hmm_evalue,hmm_target_start,hmm_target_end,complete_catalytic_hit,catalytic_site_identities
# ex.
# LG1,C001,C001-1.hmm,3.21e-19,2,150,TRUE,S130(S165):D183(E203):H213(H290)
# an accession/id can appear on multiple rows if it has multiple significant hit

PETADEX_LOGAN_ID_MAP="../s3/6_logan_search_qc/petadex-logan.v260701.id_map.tsv" # one row per LG petadex_id
# column format (tsv):
# petadex_id	component_id	shard	record_index	logan_header
# ex.
# LG1	C027	00000	1	DRR001727_408_ka:f:2.500____|8.68e-17|46.5|NR5562854|C027
# record_index is the 1-based record number in DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR/petadex-logan.significant-hits.{shard}.{component_id}.fa

# ─── SCRIPTS  ─── #
SEARCH_SCRIPT="../s3/6_logan_search_qc/scripts/hmmsearch-261006.sh"
TRANSFER_SCRIPT="../s3/6_logan_search_qc/scripts/hmmsearch-261006.transfer_annotations.py"
PARSE_SCRIPT="../s3/6_logan_search_qc/scripts/hmmsearch-261006.parse_output.py"

# ─── PARAMETERS  ─── #
NCBI_SIZE=1101054423

# ─── RUN SCRIPT  ─── #
bash "${SEARCH_SCRIPT}" \
  --transfer-script "${TRANSFER_SCRIPT}" \
  --parse-script "${PARSE_SCRIPT}" \
  --master-directory "${MASTER_DIRECTORY}" \
  --input-hmms-path "${PLASTICOME_HMMS}" \
  --component-database-directory "${DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR}" \
  --total-search-size "${NCBI_SIZE}" \
  --reference-annotations "${ANNOTATIONS}" \
  --output-annotations-csv "${PETADEX_LOGAN_HMM_ANNOTATIONS}" \
  --output-id-map "${PETADEX_LOGAN_ID_MAP}"

```

```bash
%%bash

# ─────────────────────────────── #
# VIEW THE HMMSEARCH RUN PROGRESS #
# ─────────────────────────────── #
MASTER_DIRECTORY="./6_logan_search_qc/working/hmmsearch"

# ─── INPUT  ─── #
DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR="./6_logan_search_qc/working/dudplicated_component_fastaas" # 100 per component
PLASTICOME_HMMS="../s3/4_hmm_creation/petadex_hmms" # file format petadex.v260701-{sub_component_id}.hmm

# ─── PARAMETERS  ─── #
N_PIPELINE_LOG_LINES=15 # tail of pipeline.log to print

PIPELINE_LOG="${MASTER_DIRECTORY}/logs/pipeline.log"
JOB_LOG_DIRECTORY="${MASTER_DIRECTORY}/logs/jobs"
STATS_DIRECTORY="${MASTER_DIRECTORY}/working/analysis/stats"

# ─── EXPECTED JOBS: EVERY HMM x EVERY SHARD OF ITS BARE COMPONENT ─── #
n_expected=0
for hmm_file in "${PLASTICOME_HMMS}"/*.hmm; do
  sub_component_id="${hmm_file##*/}"; sub_component_id="${sub_component_id%.hmm}"; sub_component_id="${sub_component_id#*-}"
  bare_component_id="${sub_component_id%%-*}"
  n_shards=$(ls "${DEDUP_FASTAA_DIR}"/petadex-logan.significant-hits.*."${bare_component_id}".fa 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  (( n_expected += n_shards ))
done

# ─── JOB STATES ─── #
n_done=$(ls "${STATS_DIRECTORY}" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '\.csv$')
n_running=$(pgrep -fc "[h]mmsearch --cpu 10 -Z") # [h] keeps pgrep from matching this cell itself
script_running=$(pgrep -fc "[h]mmsearch-261006.sh") # the search script itself (alive between launches and during finalize)
killed_jobs=$(grep -l "Killed" "${JOB_LOG_DIRECTORY}"/*.log 2>/dev/null) # hmmsearch killed (e.g. out of memory)
error_jobs=$(grep -l "Traceback\|Error" "${JOB_LOG_DIRECTORY}"/*.log 2>/dev/null)

echo "# ─── PIPELINE LOG (last ${N_PIPELINE_LOG_LINES} lines) ─── #"
tail -n "${N_PIPELINE_LOG_LINES}" "${PIPELINE_LOG}"
echo
echo "# ─── JOB SUMMARY ─── #"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "expected (HMM x shard):" "${n_expected}"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "finished (stats csv):" "${n_done}"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "remaining:" "$(( n_expected - n_done ))"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "hmmsearch running now:" "${n_running}"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "hmmsearch killed:" "$(grep -c . <<< "${killed_jobs}")"
printf "%-28s %s\n" "python errors:" "$(grep -c . <<< "${error_jobs}")"
if grep -q "All HMMs searched" "${PIPELINE_LOG}"; then
  echo "status: FINISHED"
elif (( n_running > 0 )); then
  echo "status: RUNNING"
elif (( script_running > 0 )); then
  echo "status: RUNNING (script alive, no hmmsearch at this moment — starting up, between jobs, or finalizing)"
else
  echo "status: STOPPED BEFORE FINISHING (rerun section 2.3 to resume)"
fi
echo
echo "# ─── FINISHED JOBS PER HMM ─── #"
ls "${STATS_DIRECTORY}" 2>/dev/null | grep '\.csv$' | sed 's/\.[0-9]*\.csv$//' | sort | uniq -c | awk '{printf "%s:%s  ", $2, $1} END {print ""}'
echo
echo "# ─── KILLED JOBS PER HMM ─── #"
# an explicit if, not `grep -c ... && ...`: with no killed jobs grep exits 1, and as the
# cell's last command that exit status made %%bash raise CalledProcessError
if [[ -n "${killed_jobs}" ]]; then
  sed 's|.*/||; s/\.[0-9]*\.log$//' <<< "${killed_jobs}" | sort | uniq -c | awk '{printf "%s:%s  ", $2, $1} END {print ""}'
else
  echo "(none)"
fi
```
